policy.title: Research commercialisation
policy.interpretation: RDI financing is a documented emphasis on private-sector and higher-TRL research. Whether it broadens research capacity requires evidence of disbursement and outcomes.
policy.test: Compare announced corpus, commitments, disbursement, firm participation and research outputs.

policy.title: Digital public infrastructure
policy.interpretation: Payments, identity, public-service access and data-sharing form a cross-agency policy area. Publication frequency alone does not establish fiscal priority.
policy.test: Compare adoption, exclusion, reliability, privacy safeguards and independent evaluations.

policy.title: Manufacturing and technology capacity
policy.interpretation: Semiconductor, AI and sectoral incentives provide hypotheses about strategic capacity-building. Assess each instrument and fiscal year separately.
policy.test: Compare budget allocations, actual expenditure, domestic value addition and technology dependence.

policy.title: Energy transition and security
policy.interpretation: Solar, green hydrogen and conventional energy programmes coexist. The balance must be examined using budgets, deployment and supply-security evidence.
policy.test: Compare installed capacity, utilisation, imports, fiscal support and distributional effects.

policy.title: Household services and inclusion
policy.interpretation: Housing, water, health and benefit-delivery programmes warrant joint analysis of reach and service quality. Registrations are not the same as sustained benefits.
policy.test: Compare eligibility, uptake, exclusion, actual delivery and audit findings.

coverage_note: All 53 configured Union ministry portfolios and two independent departments have monitoring routes. The programme index is curated, not an exhaustive or synchronised copy of every central/state scheme. myScheme and the national directory provide wider discovery. Listed programmes are not necessarily accepting applications.
